## Change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior, and any relevant issue (for example, `Closes #123`).

## Validation

List checks you ran and their results. Add screenshots for visible changes.

## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, etc.).
- [ ] Relevant tests and documentation are updated.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes; browser/binary checks were run when relevant.
- [ ] No credentials, local state, or private conversation data are included.
- [ ] Review conversations are resolved before requesting final approval.
